name: Home First Finance Company India Ltd
about: Home First Finance Company India (HFFC) is a Housing Finance Company which offers home loan with 48 hours sanctions and hassle-free process. [1]
keyPoints: Offerings[1] The company is a technology-driven affordable housing finance company with a pan-India presence, focused on first-time homebuyers from families earning below Rs. 50,000 per month. Housing loans account for 83% of AUM with an average ticket size of ~Rs. 12 lakh. The company has a diversified lender base of 31 banks/FIs, positive ALM, no commercial paper exposure, and utilizes data-driven underwriting and proprietary credit scoring models. Its distribution network covers ~80% of India's affordable housing market.
pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 40.1% CAGR over last 5 years
Company's median sales growth is 39.5% of last 10 years
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -23.2%
